title: Area accountant methodically reads entire fifty page software licensing agreement before installing update
text: Stunned roommates and family members looked on in utter disbelief Tuesday morning as thirty-two year old certified accountant Kevin Matthews spent six consecutive hours reviewing all sixty clauses of an operating system update agreement before checking the accept terms box.
notes: Satirical fiction. Intentional parody of consumer behavior, not deceptive misinformation.

title: Department of Transportation mandates formal handwritten apology letters for airline passengers experiencing flight delays
text: Under sweeping new consumer transit directives published Friday, passengers delayed for more than thirty minutes must personally submit handwritten apology notices to airline gate personnel thanking them for their dedicated efforts to ensure aircraft maintenance readiness.
notes: Satirical political parody. Fictional government directive.

title: Scientists discover new species of deep ocean fish that already hates Mondays
text: Marine biologists exploring the Mariana Trench announced the discovery of a bioluminescent abyssal fish whose facial structure and neurological signals indicate an instinctive dread of starting another five-day work week.

title: Man successfully explains cryptocurrency to relatives using increasingly desperate hand gestures
text: A family dinner erupted into polite bewilderment Sunday as twenty-eight year old software engineer Tom Logan spent forty-five uninterrupted minutes explaining decentralized blockchain validation while frantically waving his arms to represent digital ledger blocks.
